alt: Two box plots on a score axis from 10 to 90, marked every 10, both running from 20 to 80. Class A has its box from lower quartile 30 to upper quartile 50 with the median at 40. Class B has its box from lower quartile 48 to upper quartile 60 with the median at 55. Class A's box is wider and sits to the left; Class B's box is narrow and sits to the right.
